question: While a spell with split second is on the stack, can players turn face-down creatures face up?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: players may turn face-down creatures face up while a spell with split second is on the stack.
expected.answer: Players may turn face-down creatures face up while a spell with split second is on the stack.
